(Capacity: 2,750) |champion= |tourney= |tourney_result= }} {{2020–21 Big West men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 UC Riverside Highlanders men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of California, Riverside]] in the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Highlanders, led by first-year head coach [[Mike Magpayo]], played their home games at [[UC Riverside Student Recreation Center|SRC Arena]] in [[Riverside, California]] as members of the [[Big West Conference]]. ==Previous season== {{main|2019–20 UC Riverside Highlanders men's basketball team}} The Highlanders finished the [[2019–20 UC Riverside Highlanders men's basketball team|2019–20 season]] 17–15, 6–9 in Big West play to finish sixth in the Big West Conference standings. Initially set to play [[2019–20 UC Santa Barbara Gauchos men's basketball team|UC Santa Barbara]] in the [[2020 Big West Conference men's basketball tournament|Big West Conference tournament]], the tournament was cancelled due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], ending the Highlanders' season.{{cite web |title=Big West Cancels 2020 Basketball Tournament |url=https://gohighlanders.com/news/2020/3/12/mens-basketball-big-west-cancels-2020-basketball-tournament.aspx |website=UC Riverside Athletics |access-date=4 December 2020}} On July 1, 2020, associate head coach [[Mike Magpayo]] was elevated to head coach of the program, replacing [[David Patrick (basketball)|David Patrick]], who had accepted an associate coach position at [[Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball|Arkansas]].{{cite web |title=Mike Magpayo becomes first NCAA Div. 1 head coach of Filipino descent |url=https://www.espn.com/basketball/story/_/id/29403279/mike-magpayo-becomes-first-ncaa-div-1-head-coach-filipino-descent |website=ESPN |access-date=4 December 2020}} Magpayo, who is [[Filipino Americans|Filipino–American]], thus became the first head coach of Asian descent in [[NCAA Division I|Division I]] men's basketball history.{{cite news|url=https://www.si.com/college/2020/11/25/mike-magpayo-uc-riverside-basketball|title='It’s a Responsibility': History-Making Mike Magpayo Ready to Make a Difference On and Off the Court|last=Steinberg|first=Emma|date=25 November 2020|work=[[Sports Illustrated]]|access-date=12 December 2021}}{{cite news|url=https://sports.inquirer.net/397775/filipino-coach-mike-magpayo-makes-us-ncaa-division-1-history|title=Filipino coach Mike Magpayo makes US NCAA Division 1
